rationale: EV-IC-001 line 55 records 'B=14, m=2 only; all Groebner solves on trivial ideals (no decompositions)' and EV-STR-002 line 55 records 'All Groebner solves on trivial ideals (no decompositions at B >= 27)'. A support verdict whose own evidence record says the mechanism never fired is the highest-value uncertainty in the ledger, and it is checkable by counting rather than by a new solver.

IDEA-20260727-002 is cost low/low and needs no new instance, no new solve and no new timing: the reachable set at B = 14, m = 2 has at most 4*(C(14,2)+14) = 420 elements regardless of N, so the yield is exactly enumerable at every one of the 34 committed instances. The whole control is arithmetic over committed records.

The control is decisive in both directions. If the measured yield obeys the counting bound, the charged descent cost grows linearly in N and the reported crossover is an accounting artifact within its own tested scope. If the deterministic EXP-IC-001 targets land in the reachable set far more often than uniform counting permits (falsifier F2), the confound claim is wrong and H-IC-001 stands as decided.

The H-STR-002 structured-solve wall-time contract is NOT the flagship of this batch. Under the governing rule that a target-class result changes the asymptotic exponent or an equally central structural barrier, a measured wall-time win for a structured or Toeplitz solve is a constant- or polynomial-cofactor engineering result; the corpus linear-algebra map calls this lane poly, not exponential. DEC-20260726-007 additionally classified the endomorphism oracle SIMULABLE with C = 0, so any advantage there is non-generic and cannot move an exponent. It is deferred with reason, not adopted.

IDEA-20260727-001 is the natural companion control and is equally cheap, but max_concurrent is 2, the campaign is in its final batch, and its decisive metric is a fully charged end-to-end comparison that also needs a solve implementation. One control done to ledger standard beats two done partially; it is recorded as the first deferred successor.

By field_bits: 8-bit 56 of 60 runs decomposed, 12-bit 10 of 60, 16-bit 2 of 60, and 0 at 20, 24, 28, 32 and 36 bits (0 of 500 runs) and 0 across the 68 runs with no field_bits. Fixed-mode per instance: 9, 9, 10, 1, 2, 2, 1 at (bits, seed) = (8,1), (8,2), (8,3), (12,1), (12,2), (12,3), (16,3); 0 at the other 27 instances.
